run_score_main: run the score main function to score tokenized post-processed sequences from a TSV input file
run_score_with_checkpoint: run the score module with a JAX model checkpoint to compute log probabilities of input sequences
run_score_with_tokenizer: run the score module using a tokenizer to load dictionary and token type ranges for scoring
run_score_add_eos_true: run the score module with add_eos set to True for word sequences
run_score_add_eos_false: run the score module with add_eos set to False for tree sequences
